links.outcome: Presence of hallucinated references in LLM responses
links.effect: All seven models exhibited hallucinated references and a lack of patient-specific reasoning; Copilot, Gemini, and ERNIE demonstrated critical errors.
links.quote: However, all models exhibited hallucinated references and a lack of patient-specific reasoning.

screen.reason: The study empirically evaluates the performance of seven large language models against expert neonatologist responses on home phototherapy queries from a caregiver perspective, but it evaluates off-the-shelf model performance alone without testing a specific deployment practice or guardrail.
